Symptom / Problem: Final IEP generation produced error: 'Failed to generate AI goals: Goal generation failed'
Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys): 1. Local Ollama server was offline. 2. Endpoint had no fallback mechanism. 3. Parameter special_factor_notes was formatted inconsistently between FE and BE.
Resolution & Code Fix: Implemented 3-Tier Fallback Cascade in iep_generation_service.py (Ollama -> Groq -> Deterministic) and normalized payload parameter naming.

Symptom / Problem: Assistive technology list grew unbounded without limit or quick standard options.
Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys): No max-length constraint or presets existed in IepGenerationPage.jsx.
Resolution & Code Fix: Added MAX_ASSISTIVE_TECH_ITEMS = 5 boundary, disabled button states, (Maximum 5 reached) badge, and 6 preset chips.

Symptom / Problem: Navigation between Overview and Student Profiles triggered redundant network refetches.
Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys): Components fetched data on every mount with no caching layer.
Resolution & Code Fix: Wrapped app in TanStack Query with staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000 (5 minutes) and automatic background invalidation.

Symptom / Problem: Secrets and localhost URLs hardcoded across codebase.
Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys): Hardcoded development endpoints were checked into git.
Resolution & Code Fix: Replaced hardcoded values with .env variables (VITE_API_BASE_URL), centralized api/client.js, and added validation checks.
